name: inbox-github
title: GitHub inbox
description: Turns a pull request's incoming reviews and comments into inbox items — the normalized queue of things people said to us, which the cockpit renders and the operator answers in one batch. The adapter is the only part that knows what GitHub calls a diff hunk; everything downstream is provider-agnostic core.

includeBots.description: Also ingest bot comments (off by default — they are not review feedback)

docs.description: Use when people have commented on this session's pull request — to watch it, to read what they said in the Inbox tab, and to act on what the operator decided. Never reply to anyone directly; the operator submits the batch.
